shortDescription: Create, update or delete Syslog servers from HyperCore API.

options.name: host
options.description: An IP address or hostname of the Syslog server you wish to create, update or delete.

options.name: host_new
options.description: An IP address or hostname with which the existing Syslog server host on the HyperCore API will be updated.

options.name: port
options.description: Network port of the syslog server.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Network protocol used to send syslog alerts.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the syslog server on HyperCore API. If I(state=present) a new Syslog server will be added, or existing Syslog server with matching C(host) will be updated. C(host) of existing Syslog server can be changed by specifying both C(host) and C(host_new). If I(state=absent), the Syslog server with the provided C(host) will be removed from HyperCore API. If I(state=set), then C(syslog_servers) will be used to configure HyperCore API.

options.name: syslog_servers
options.description: List of syslog servers to set.
